note: Adapted from the original English description published with this species by Bacchus (1997); both the soldier and the large worker are described in prose, with measurement tables; the alate is given in the original as IMAGO. Unknown. That work groups this species with lokoriensis, redenianus, luteus and pamelae in a set with 14-segmented antennae. Many numbers in the OCR measurement table are misplaced, so only readable and mutually consistent values are cited.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to pale orange; labrum paler than the head; antennae, pronotum, abdomen and legs yellowish white to pale yellow; mandibles reddish brown with yellow bases; postmentum yellow to pale orange, darker than the genae. Head capsule long-oval, widest posteriorly, narrowing near the antennal sockets; head setae numerous, regularly and symmetrically arranged; labrum broadly ligulate, with 8 setae on the anterior half. Mandibles stout, apex moderately to strongly incurved; antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shortest, slightly shorter than segment 4, segments 1 and 2 subequal; postmentum moderately long and broad. Pronotum saddle-shaped, lateral lobes with numerous setae, a moderately deep V-shaped median notch between the anterior lobes, posterior lobe large, semicircular, margin slightly concave. Fore tibia moderately inflated, spurs 3, the dorsal spur longer than half the outer ventral spur. A long seta on the fore coxa not spine-like.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head capsule yellow; mandibles brown with yellow bases; antennae, postclypeus, pronotum, legs and abdomen pale yellow. Head capsule subrectangular, sides almost parallel, posterior margin broadly and evenly rounded; head setae numerous, regularly and symmetrically arranged; cranial suture absent; postclypeus inflated, thin-bean-shaped, with an indistinct median suture; anteclypeus flat, slightly projecting in the middle; labrum with an incomplete transverse sclerotic band, apex broadly rounded; antennae 14-segmented, segments 3 and 4 similar, slightly smaller than segment 5, segments 1 and 2 subequal. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior lobe small, anterior margin shallowly V-shaped in the middle, outer corners rounded, posterior margin nearly straight. Fore tibia not inflated; fore coxa conical, the large anterior seta not spine-like, spurs 3, the dorsal spur well developed, almost as long as the ventral outer spur.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Soldier measurements (4 heads, 2 colonies, mm): head length including mandibles 1.53—1.55, head length to mandible base 1.02—1.03, head width behind antennal sockets 0.80—0.83, maximum head width 0.83—0.87, labrum length 0.30—0.33, width 0.26—0.28, left mandible transverse length 0.58—0.60, width 0.08—0.09, mandible curvature 0.08, fore tibia length 0.55—0.60, width 0.15, hind tibia length 0.70, width 0.10, maximum pronotum width 0.55, postmentum length 0.53—0.58, maximum width 0.35—0.38. Large-worker measurements (4 heads): head length to anterior margin of postclypeus 1.02—1.05, maximum head width 0.90—0.94, postclypeal pad length 0.20—0.23, width 0.37—0.38, maximum pronotum width 0.50, fore tibia 0.50×0.10, hind tibia length 0.58—0.60, width 0.07. Holotype soldier collected from a dead tree stump at Zomba, Malawi. Alate unknown.
